transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I can’t shake the belief that my spouse and friends have been secretly plotting behind my back, no matter how much they deny it. It has been causing a lot of tension, so I was referred here to get some help with what's been going on.
Besides these suspicions, have you ever experienced hearing voices that others cannot hear, or felt that you were receiving special messages through the television or radio?

No, I have never heard any voices that other people couldn't hear. I also have never felt like the television or radio was sending me special messages. My concerns are strictly about what my spouse and friends are doing.

Do you often feel that people around you are generally untrustworthy, exploitative, or out to harm you in various areas of your life, even outside of your current concerns about your spouse and friends?

No, not at all. I don't feel this way about people in general, and I actually get along really well with my staff and run my store smoothly. This issue is strictly limited to my spouse and close friends.
How long have you held these specific beliefs about your spouse and friends, and have you noticed any other changes in your behavior or daily functioning since they started?

These beliefs started about a year and nine months ago, around the time of a store remodel when I was traveling a lot. My work and daily routine are completely fine, but this has caused a lot of strain, arguments, and distance in my marriage and friendships.
Have you ever experienced any periods of significantly depressed or elevated mood, such as feeling extremely sad or unusually energetic, that coincided with these suspicions?

No, I haven't really experienced any extreme emotional highs or deep depressions. It's just been the ongoing stress and suspicion regarding my spouse and friends that has been weighing on me. My mood is otherwise pretty stable.
Do you have any other unusual beliefs, such as the feeling that your spouse or friends are being replaced by imposters, or that they are physically poisoning your food or belongings?

No, I definitely don't think they are imposters or trying to poison me. My concern is strictly that they are secretly plotting behind my back, using group chats and code words to talk about me and test my loyalty. It's just about them communicating secretly and testing how I'll react.

Apart from the strain on your relationships, have these concerns about your spouse and friends ever caused you to change your daily habits, such as checking their phones, recording conversations, or avoiding specific social settings?

I do find myself looking closely for secret signs, and my spouse has even shown me their messages to try to reassure me, but I don't secretly record conversations or avoid social settings. Outside of these arguments, my daily habits are completely normal, and I still run my store and manage my staff without any issues.
